verdict.rationale: Superset orchestrates CLI coding agents, so configuring an agent's approval mode is a fair question for this product. The evidence never documents any auto-approve, permission-mode or skip-confirmation setting. The closest items are notifications when an agent "pauses for your input" and scheduled automations, which are adjacent features and do not show a configurable auto-approve capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure an agent to auto-approve all its actions instead of confirming each one
